decision: Activate training and validation for the nine languages the owner approved verbatim from the B5 training recommendation (owner: 'approve the 9 and we'll fix akan/serer later', 'approve the thresholds', 'Launch the campaign'). Every other scoped language keeps an explicit non-active disposition. This is the first scope decision since B4-SCOPE-2026-001 under which any language is training-active.

not_amended_or_reinterpreted: platform/decisions/B5-AUTH-2026-001-refusal-engineering.json remains a frozen negative proof of the B4-B5-SCOPE-2026-003 world; its registry snapshot is byte-pinned at platform/evidence/B5-REFUSAL-WORLD-REGISTRY-2026-001/ and this activation does not reopen the historical whisper candidate.
Historical campaign, validation and termination evidence keeps its original meaning.

language_scope.partition_rule: active_training equals active_validation (the T6 gate validates exactly the trained set). Active, deferred, inactive_not_evaluated and promotion_not_applicable are pairwise disjoint and together exactly cover the generated registry scope. Every active language carries recommendation TRAIN in the referenced owner-approved recommendation; activation by yaml edit without that backing is refused by scripts/generate_languages.py.
